data.titulo: Tasal 2—Chalen Chaq li Bʼutʼihaʼ Toj saʼ Xkamikebʼ laj Egipto
data.contenido:
Kaʼajwiʼ laj Noe ut li xjunkabʼal keʼkoleʼk saʼ li bʼutʼihaʼ. Abʼan saʼ xnumikebʼ ru li chihabʼ keʼtamk li qas qiitzʼin. Ak 352 chihabʼ xnumik li bʼutʼihaʼ naq kiyoʼlaak laj Abrahan. Saʼ li tasal aʼin tqatzol, chanru naq li Yos kixkʼe laj Isaac choʼq ralal laj Abrahan. Laj Isaac kiwank wiibʼ ralal, jun rehebʼ li ralal xkʼabʼaʼ Jacob ut aʼan kisikʼeʼk ru xbʼaan li Yos.

Nim li xjunkabʼal laj Jacob. Kiwank ebʼ li xrabʼin ut 12 li ralal. Lajeebʼ rehebʼ li ralal laj Jacob xikʼ keʼril laj Jose ut keʼxkʼayi rikʼinebʼ laj Egipto. Kiwank xwankil laj Jose saʼ li tenamit Egipto. Naq kichalk li weʼej, laj Jose kixyalebʼ rix li ras. Tojaʼ naq li xjunkabʼal laj Jacob ut chixjunilebʼ laj Israel kohebʼ Egipto. Ak 290 chihabʼ xyoʼlajik laj Abrahan naq kikʼulmank aʼin.

Ebʼ laj Israel keʼwank 215 chihabʼ saʼ li tenamit Egipto. Naq kikamk laj Jose, ebʼ laj Israel keʼkanaak choʼq moos saʼ li tenamit aʼin. Moqon chik, kiyoʼlaak laj Moises. Aʼan kitaqlaak xbʼaan li Yos chi risinkilebʼ laj Israel saʼ li tenamit Egipto. Chixjunil li naxchʼolobʼ li XKABʼ Tasal li hu aʼin, kikʼulmank chaq chiru 857 chihabʼ.

MA NAKAANAW kʼaru kixbʼaanu laj Noe ut li xjunkabʼal naq keʼelk saʼ li jukubʼ kabʼl? Laj Noe kimayejak chiru li Yos. Saʼ li eetalil nakʼutunk chanru kixbʼaanu. Laj Noe kixmayeja ebʼ li xul re xbʼanyoxinkil re li Yos naq kixkol li xjunkabʼal chiru li bʼutʼihaʼ.

Ma kiwulak chiru li Yos naq laj Noe kimayejak? Li Yos kiwulak chiru. Joʼkan naq kixye re laj Noe naq maajunwa chik tixsach li Ruuchichʼochʼ rikʼin bʼutʼihaʼ.



Naq kichaqik li Ruuchichʼochʼ, laj Noe ut li xjunkabʼal keʼok wiʼ chik chi kabʼlak. Li Yos kirosobʼtesihebʼ ut kixye rehebʼ: ‹Chiwanq eeralal eekʼajol chexkʼihanq ut cheenujobʼresi li Ruuchichʼochʼ›.

Naq ebʼ li qas qiitzʼin teʼrabʼi resil li bʼutʼihaʼ, maare teʼxkʼoxla naq tbʼutʼunq wiʼ chik li Ruuchichʼochʼ. Joʼkan naq li Yos kixkʼe jun li eetalil, re naq ebʼ li poyanam teʼxjultika naq li Yos maajunwa chik tixsach li Ruuchichʼochʼ rikʼin haʼ. Ma nakaanaw, kʼaru li eetalil aʼin? Aʼan li kaqlaaqʼ.

Li kaqlaaqʼ naxkʼut ribʼ saʼ choxa naq naraqeʼk li habʼ ut naq naʼelk chaq li Saqʼe. Li kaqlaaqʼ jalan jalanq xbʼonol. Ma aawilom ru junaq li kaqlaaqʼ? Chaawil li wank saʼ li eetalil.

Li Yos kixye aʼin: ‹Maajunwa chik tinsachebʼ li xul ut ebʼ li poyanam rikʼin bʼutʼihaʼ. Tinkʼe jun li kaqlaaqʼ saʼebʼ li choql ut naq t-elq chaq li kaqlaaqʼ tjultikoʼq we li sumwank li xinbʼaanu chaq eerikʼin›.

Joʼkan naq, kʼaru tento taajultika naq taawil li kaqlaaqʼ? Taajultika naq li Yos kixye naq maajunwa chik tixsach li Ruuchichʼochʼ rikʼin bʼutʼihaʼ.Génesis 8:18-22; 9:9-17. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

SAʼ XNUMIKEBʼ li chihabʼ, ebʼ li ralal laj Noe keʼwank naabʼal ralal xkʼajol ut ebʼ li ri laj Noe, keʼwank ajwiʼ xkokʼal. Joʼkan naq keʼtamk li qas qiitzʼin saʼ Ruuchichʼochʼ.

Jun rehebʼ li ri xmam laj Noe, aʼan laj Nemrod. Laj Nemrod maaʼus xnaʼlebʼ, xbʼaan naq nawulak chiru xkamsinkilebʼ li qas qiitzʼin ut ebʼ li xul. Kixkʼe ribʼ choʼq awabʼej saʼ xbʼeenebʼ li qas qiitzʼin. Li Yos inkʼaʼ kiwulak chiru li xnaʼlebʼ laj Nemrod. Saʼ xkutankil laj Nemrod, jun ajwiʼ li aatinobʼaal kiwank. Laj Nemrod kiraj naq chixjunilebʼ teʼwanq saʼ jun chi naʼajej re naq truuq chi taqlank saʼ xbʼeenebʼ. Joʼkan naq, ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixbʼaanu? Kixye rehebʼ li poyanam naq teʼxyiibʼ jun li tenamit ut jun li nimla ochoch. Saʼ li eetalil nakʼutunk naq yookebʼ xyiibʼankil li xan.

Li Jehobʼa inkʼaʼ kiwulak chiru naq yookebʼ xyiibʼankil li ochoch. Li Yos kiraj naq ebʼ li poyanam teʼwanq saʼ xbʼeen chixjunil li Ruuchichʼochʼ. Abʼan ebʼ li qas qiitzʼin keʼxye: ‹Qayiibʼaq junaq li tenamit ut jun nimla ochoch toj twulaq saʼ choxa li xteram. Re naq teʼxnaw qu›. Chi joʼkan keʼxkʼutbʼesi naq keʼraj naq teʼkʼeheʼq xloqʼal ut inkʼaʼ keʼxkʼoxla naq li loqʼal tento xkʼeebʼal re li Yos.

Joʼkan naq li Yos kixbʼaanu naq teʼxkanabʼ xyiibʼankil li ochoch. Ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixbʼaanu li Yos? Maakʼaʼ saʼ xchʼoolebʼ laj Babel naq li Yos kixbʼaanu naq teʼoq chi aatinak saʼ jalan jalanq chi aatinobʼaal. Ut maaʼani chik kixtaw ru li nekeʼxye chiribʼilebʼ ribʼ. Joʼkan naq li tenamit aʼin kixkʼabʼaʼi Babel malaj Babilonia.

Chirix chik aʼan, keʼok xkanabʼankil li tenamit Babel. Li nekeʼxtaw ru raatinobʼalebʼ keʼxchʼutubʼ ribʼ ut kohebʼ saʼ jalan chik naʼaj, chi joʼkan keʼxjekʼi ribʼ saʼ Ruuchichʼochʼ.Génesis 10:1, 8; 11:1-9. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

NAQ kinumeʼk li bʼutʼihaʼ, wankebʼ li qas qiitzʼin kohebʼ saʼ li tenamit Ur. Aʼan jun nimla tenamit ut chʼinaʼusebʼ li ochoch aran. Saʼ li tenamit aʼin, yookebʼ chaq ajwiʼ xloqʼoninkil li pechʼbʼil yos joʼ keʼxbʼaanu chaq Babel. Ebʼ li keʼwank saʼ li tenamit Ur ut Babel moko keʼxloqʼoni ta li Jehobʼa joʼ keʼxbʼaanu laj Noe ut laj Sem.

Ak 350 chihabʼ xnumik li bʼutʼihaʼ naq kikamk laj Noe. Wiibʼ chihabʼ xkamik laj Noe naq kiyoʼlaak li winq li wank saʼ li eetalil. Aj Abrahan xkʼabʼaʼ li winq aʼin ut oxloqʼ chiru li Yos. Laj Abrahan kiwank rikʼin li xjunkabʼal saʼ li tenamit Ur.

Saʼ jun kutan li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Abrahan: ‹Kanabʼ laatenamit ut aayu saʼ li tenamit li tinkʼut chaawu›. Ma kiʼabʼink laj Abrahan chiru li Yos? Ma kixkanabʼ li rochoch? Laj Abrahan kixbʼaanu li kiyeheʼk re xbʼaan li Yos ut junelik kixpaabʼ. Joʼkan naq kixkʼabʼaʼi ramiiw li Yos.

Naq laj Abrahan kiʼelk saʼ li tenamit Ur kixkʼam chirix li xSara, laj Tare ut laj Lot, ralal li ras laj Abrahan. Ut keʼwulak saʼ li tenamit Haran. Saʼ li tenamit aʼin kikamk laj Tare, xyuwaʼ laj Abrahan. Laj Abrahan ut li xjunkabʼal najt wankebʼ chiru li tenamit Ur.

Naq laj Abrahan ut li xjunkabʼal keʼelk saʼ li tenamit Haran keʼwulak Canaan. Naq wankebʼ Canaan, li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Abrahan: ‹Aʼin li naʼaj li tinkʼe rehebʼ laawalal laakʼajol›. Joʼkan naq laj Abrahan kikanaak saʼ li tenamit Canaan.

Li Yos kirosobʼtesi laj Abrahan; kixkʼe naabʼal xkarneer, xketomq ut xmoos. Abʼan laj Abrahan ut xSara maakʼaʼebʼ xkokʼal.

Chirix chi aʼan, li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Abrahan: ‹Laaʼataq xyuwaʼil li kʼiila tenamit›. Naq kiyeheʼk re aʼin, laj Abrahan wank 99 chihabʼ re. Abʼan, chanru teʼwanq xkokʼal wi cheekebʼ chik?Génesis 11:27-32; 12:1-7; 17:1-8, 15-17; 18:9-19. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

MA NAKAANAW kʼaru yook xbʼaanunkil laj Abrahan? Chanchan naq ok re xkamsinkil li ralal! Ma nakaanaw kʼaʼut? Aatinaqo xbʼeenwa chirix li ralal laj Abrahan ut li xSara.

Ma jultik aawe naq li Yos kixye naq tixkʼe jun ralal laj Abrahan? Abʼan chanru teʼwanq xkʼuulaʼal laj Abrahan ut xSara xbʼaan naq cheekebʼ chik. Laj Abrahan naxnaw naq maakʼaʼ chʼaʼaj chiru li Yos. Qilaq chanru kikʼulmank aʼin.

Ak jun chihabʼ xnumik naq li Yos kixye re laj Abrahan naq twanq jun ralal. Naq kiyoʼlaak li kʼuulaʼal aʼin; laj Abrahan wank 100 chihabʼ re ut li xSara 90 chihabʼ. Aj Isaac keʼxkʼe choʼq xkʼabʼaʼ li kʼuulaʼal. Chi joʼkan kitzʼaqlok ru li kixye li Jehobʼa.

Ak nim chik laj Isaac, naq li Jehobʼa kixyal rix li xpaabʼal laj Abrahan. Li Jehobʼa kixye: ‹Abrahan!› Ut laj Abrahan kichaqʼok: ‹Arin wankin!› Tojaʼ naq li Yos kixye re: ‹Kʼam laawalal, li jun chaawu, saʼ li tzuul li tinye aawe. Aran taakamsi ut taamayeja chiwu›.

Kʼajoʼ naq kirahoʼk saʼ xchʼool laj Abrahan, xbʼaan naq jwal naxra li ralal! Ma jultik aawe naq li Yos kixye re laj Abrahan naq saʼ li tenamit Canaan teʼwanq li ralal xkʼajol? Chan raj ru kikʼulmank aʼin wi kikamk raj laj Isaac? Usta laj Abrahan inkʼaʼ kixtaw ru kʼaru yook chi kʼulmank, kiʼabʼink chiru li Yos.

Naq laj Abrahan kiwulak saʼ li tzuul, kixbʼakʼ laj Isaac ut kixtolobʼ bʼarwiʼ tixmayeja. Tojaʼ naq kirisi li xchʼiichʼ re xkamsinkil li ralal. Saʼ li hoonal aʼan, li xʼanjel li Yos kixye re: ‹Abrahan! Abrahan!› Kichaqʼok laj Abrahan: ‹Arin wankin!›

Tojaʼ naq li Yos kixye re: ‹Maachʼeʼ laawalal. Anaqwan ninnaw naq kaw laapaabʼal, xbʼaan naq inkʼaʼ xaaram laawalal chiwu›.

Laj Abrahan kaw xpaabʼal joʼkan naq chʼolchʼo chiru naq li Jehobʼa tixwaklesi wiʼ chik chi yoʼyo laj Isaac. Li Jehobʼa inkʼaʼ kiraj naq laj Abrahan tixkamsi laj Isaac. Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixbʼaanu naq ttʼilq jun li karneer saʼ xyanq li cheʼ. Ut kixye re laj Abrahan naq tixmayeja li karneer aʼin choʼq reqaj laj Isaac.Génesis 21:1-7; 22:1-18. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

LAJ Abrahan ut li xjunkabʼal laj Lot wankebʼ Canaan. Saʼ jun kutan laj Abrahan kixye re laj Lot: ‹Arin moko wank ta naabʼal li naʼaj choʼq rehebʼ li qaketomq. Us raj naq tqajach qibʼ, wi tatxik saʼ laatzʼe, laaʼin tinxik saʼ linnim; ut wi tatxik saʼ laanim, laaʼin tinxik saʼ lintzʼe›.

Naq laj Lot kiril xteepal li Jordan kixkʼe reetal naq chaabʼil li chʼochʼ, xbʼaan naq wank haʼ ut ichaj choʼq re li xketomq. Joʼkan naq laj Lot ut li xjunkabʼal keʼkanaak saʼ li tenamit Sodoma.

Ebʼ laj Sodoma moko chaabʼilebʼ ta xnaʼlebʼ. Laj Lot chaabʼil xnaʼlebʼ, joʼkan naq moko sa ta saʼ xchʼool saʼ xyanqebʼ li poyanam aʼin. Li Yos yook ajwiʼ xjosqʼil, joʼkan naq kixtaqla wiibʼ li anjel re xyeebʼal re laj Lot naq tixsach li tenamit Sodoma ut Gomorra.

Ebʼ li anjel keʼxye re laj Lot: ‹Seebʼa aawibʼ; kʼam laawixaqil, ebʼ laarabʼin ut elenqex arin›. Abʼan, kʼajoʼ naq keʼbʼayk chi elk. Joʼkan naq keʼchapeʼk chi ruqʼ xbʼaanebʼ li anjel ut keʼisiik saʼ li tenamit. Jun li anjel kixye rehebʼ: ‹Ayuqex saʼ li tzuul, kolomaq eeribʼ ut mexʼilok cheerix re naq inkʼaʼ texkamq!› Laj Lot ut ebʼ li xrabʼin keʼelelik ut keʼxkanabʼ li tenamit Sodoma. Inkʼaʼ keʼxaqli chi moko keʼilok ta chirix. Yookebʼ chi elelik, naq li rixaqil laj Lot kixaqli ut kiʼilok chirix. Inkʼaʼ kiʼabʼink chiru li Yos. Joʼkan naq kikanaak choʼq atzʼam joʼ nakʼutunk saʼ li eetalil.

Kʼaru naqatzol chirix aʼin? Naq li Yos naxkolebʼ li nekeʼabʼink chiru. Ut ebʼ li nekeʼxqʼet Raatin nekeʼxsach xyuʼam.Génesis 13:5-13; 18:20-33; 19:1-29; Lucas 17:28-32; 2 Pedro 2:6-8. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

MA NAKAANAW ani li ixq ut li winq wankebʼ saʼ li eetalil? Aʼan li xRebeca ut laj Isaac. Li xRebeca kikanaak choʼq rixaqil laj Isaac. Qatzolaq chanru kikʼulmank aʼin.

Laj Abrahan kiraj jun chaabʼil ixq choʼq re laj Isaac. Inkʼaʼ kiraj naq tsumlaaq rikʼinebʼ laj Canaan, xbʼaan naq aran nekeʼxloqʼoni li pechʼbʼil yos. Joʼkan naq laj Abrahan kixye re li xmoos: ‹Nawaj naq tatxik rikʼinebʼ linkomon, saʼ li tenamit Haran ut saʼ xyanqebʼ taasikʼ rixaqil li walal›.

Joʼkan naq li moos kixchap xbʼe ut kixkʼam lajeebʼ chi kameey. Naq wulak re li moos saʼ li tenamit Haran, kihilank chire jun li bʼekbʼil haʼ. Ak xʼewuuk naq ebʼ li ixq kohebʼ risinkil xhaʼ. Joʼkan naq li moos, kitzʼaamank chiru li Jehobʼa ut kixye re: ‹Li ixq li tinxkʼe chi ukʼak ut tixkʼe ajwiʼ rukʼaʼebʼ linkameey aʼan taxaq tkanaaq choʼq rixaqil laj Isaac›.

Chirix chik aʼan, kiwulak xRebeca chi risinkil xhaʼ. Li moos kixpatzʼ xhaʼ re xRebeca. Aʼan kixkʼe chi ukʼak li moos ut kixkʼe ajwiʼ chi ukʼak ebʼ li kameey xbʼaan naq teʼchaqik re. Ebʼ li kameey naabʼal haʼ nekeʼrukʼ, joʼkan naq li xRebeca kixkʼe xchʼool chi risinkil naabʼal li haʼ.

Naq li xRebeca kiraqeʼk xkʼeebʼalebʼ xhaʼ li kameey, li moos kixpatzʼ re ani li xyuwaʼ ut ma naru tkanaaq chi wark saʼebʼ li rochoch. Li xRebeca kixye: ‹Laaʼin xrabʼin laj Betuel ut naru tatkanaaq saʼ qochoch›. Li moos naxnaw naq laj Betuel ralal laj Nacor. Laj Nacor ut laj Abrahan riitzʼinebʼ ribʼ. Joʼkan naq li moos kixwiqʼibʼ ribʼ ut kixbʼanyoxi re li Jehobʼa, xbʼaan naq aʼan kikʼamok re rikʼinebʼ li xkomon laj Abrahan.

Saʼ li qʼoqyink ajwiʼ aʼan li xmoos laj Abrahan kixye re laj Betuel ut re laj Laban, ras li xRebeca, kʼaru aj e naq kiwulak rikʼinebʼ. Laj Betuel ut laj Laban keʼxye naq naru tixkʼam xRebeca choʼq rixaqil laj Isaac. Kʼaru kixye xRebeca naq kipatzʼeʼk re aʼin? Li xRebeca kixye naq traj xik chirix li moos. Ut naq kisaqewk keʼsutqʼiik Canaan.

Ak yook chi ok li qʼoqyink naq keʼwulak Canaan. Li xRebeca kiril naq laj Isaac yook chaq chi chalk. Kʼajoʼ naq kisahoʼk saʼ xchʼool laj Isaac naq kiril xRebeca. Toj ra saʼ xchʼool laj Isaac, xbʼaan naq oxibʼ chihabʼ xkamik li xnaʼ. Abʼan, naq kisumlaak rikʼin xRebeca kisahoʼk wiʼ chik saʼ xchʼool.Génesis 24:1-67. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Ani Laj Esau ut laj Jacob?
data.contenido:
MA JUNTAQʼEET nekeʼilok ebʼ li chʼinaʼal li wankebʼ saʼ li eetalil? Jalan nekeʼilok. Anihebʼ xkʼabʼaʼ? Laj chapol xul aʼan aj Esau ut laj kʼaakʼalenel karneer aʼan aj Jacob.

Laj Esau ut laj Jacob lutebʼ ut aʼanebʼ xkokʼal laj Isaac ut xRebeca. Laj Esau raaro xbʼaan li xyuwaʼ xbʼaan naq naxkʼam li tzakahemq saʼ rochoch. Abʼan, li xRebeca naxra laj Jacob xbʼaan naq chaabʼil ut tuulan xchʼool.



Laj Jacob kiwulak tana chiru rabʼinkil laj Abrahan, li xyuwaʼchin, naq naʼaatinak chirix li Jehobʼa! Laj Abrahan kikamk naq wank 175 chihabʼ re ut 15 chihabʼ wankebʼ re li lut.

Laj Esau wank 40 chihabʼ re naq kisumlaak rikʼinebʼ wiibʼ li ixq aj Canaan. Kʼajoʼ naq keʼrahoʼk saʼ xchʼool laj Isaac ut xRebeca, xbʼaan naq ebʼ li ixq aʼin, inkʼaʼ nekeʼxloqʼoni li Jehobʼa.

Saʼ jun kutan, laj Esau kijosqʼoʼk rikʼin laj Jacob. Ma nakaanaw kʼaʼut? Kiwulak xqʼehil naq laj Isaac trosobʼtesi li xbʼeen ralal. Laj Esau asbʼej chiru laj Jacob joʼkan naq laj Esau kixkʼoxla naq aʼan t-osobʼtesiiq. Abʼan laj Esau ak xkʼayi li rosobʼtesihom re laj Jacob. Naq keʼyoʼlaak ebʼ li lut aʼin, li Yos ak kixye naq laj Jacob tixkʼul li osobʼtesiik aʼin. Joʼkan naq laj Isaac kirosobʼtesi laj Jacob.

Naq laj Esau kixnaw aʼin, kʼajoʼ naq kichalk xjosqʼil rikʼin laj Jacob, joʼkan naq kixye naq tixkamsi. Naq li xRebeca kirabʼi li tixbʼaanu laj Esau, kʼajoʼ naq kixuwak. Joʼkan naq kixye re laj Isaac, li xbʼeelom: ‹Moko tinkuy ta rilbʼal naq laj Jacob tsumlaaq rikʼin junaq li ixq aj Canaan›.

Chirix chik aʼan, laj Isaac kixbʼoq laj Jacob ut kixye re: ‹Matsumla rikʼin junaq ixq aj Canaan. Ayu saʼ li tenamit Haran saʼ rochoch laayuwaʼchin, Betuel. Ut sumlan rikʼin junaq rehebʼ li xrabʼin laj Laban›.

Laj Jacob kixpaabʼ i xyuwaʼ ut xko saʼ li tenamit Haran.Génesis 25:5-11, 20-34; 26:34, 35; 27:1-46; 28:1-5; Hebreos 12:16, 17. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Laj Jacob Xko saʼ li Tenamit Haran
data.contenido:
MA NAKAANAW anihebʼ li winq wankebʼ rikʼin laj Jacob? Ak yook chi wulak laj Jacob saʼ li tenamit Haran. Naq ebʼ li winq aʼin yookebʼ xkʼaakʼalenkil ebʼ li xkarneer chixkʼatq jun li bʼekbʼil haʼ. Tojaʼ naq laj Jacob kixye rehebʼ: ‹Bʼar nekexchalk?›

‹Laaʼo aj Haran› chankebʼ.

Kixye laj Jacob: ‹Ma nekeenaw ru laj Laban?›

Ebʼ li winq keʼxye: ‹Naqanaw ru. Chaawil yook chaq chi chalk li xrabʼin laj Laban rikʼinebʼ li xkarneer›. Ma nakaawil li xRaquel saʼ li eetalil? Naq laj Jacob kiril ru li xRaquel, kirisi chaq li pek saʼ xbʼeen xjulel li haʼ re naq teʼukʼaq ebʼ li xkarneer. Laj Jacob kixtzʼubʼ ru xRaquel ut kixye re naq aʼan xkomon. Kisahoʼk saʼ xchʼool li xRaquel ut kixye chaq re li xyuwaʼ li kixkʼul.

Laj Laban sa saʼ xchʼool naq laj Jacob kikanaak saʼ rochoch. Naq laj Jacob kixye naq traj sumlaak rikʼin xRaquel, laj Laban kisahoʼk saʼ xchʼool. Laj Laban kixye re laj Jacob naq tkʼanjelaq rikʼin wuqubʼ chihabʼ, re naq tsumlaaq rikʼin li xRaquel. Laj Jacob kixkʼulubʼa aʼin, xbʼaan naq naxra li xRaquel chi anchal xchʼool. Naq kiwulak xkutankil xsumlajikebʼ, ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixbʼaanu laj Laban?

Laj Laban kixsumubʼ li xLea rikʼin laj Jacob choʼq reqaj li xRaquel. Li xLea asbʼej chiru xRaquel. Naq laj Jacob kixsume kʼanjelak wuqubʼ chihabʼ chik rikʼin laj Laban, kikʼeheʼk ajwiʼ xRaquel choʼq rixaqil. Saʼebʼ li kutan aʼin li Yos kixkanabʼ naq ebʼ li winq teʼxbʼaanu aʼin. Abʼan saʼebʼ li qakutan, li Santil Hu naxye naq ebʼ li winq tento naq teʼsumlaaq rikʼin jun ajwiʼ li ixq.Génesis 29:1-30. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Ebʼ Li Ralal Xkʼajol laj Jacob
data.contenido:
KʼE REETAL naabʼalebʼ saʼ li junkabʼal aʼin. Kabʼlaju ralal laj Jacob ut moko kaʼaj tawiʼ jun xrabʼin kiwank. Ma nakaanaw anihebʼ xkʼabʼaʼ li ralal? Qatzolaq anihebʼ.

Ebʼ li xkokʼal li xLea aʼanebʼ: laj Ruben, laj Simeon, laj Levi ut laj Juda. Naq li xRaquel kixkʼe reetal naq inkʼaʼ naru nawank xkokʼal kirahoʼk saʼ xchʼool. Joʼkan naq kixkʼe li xmoos, xBilha xkʼabʼaʼ, re laj Jacob. Li xBilha kiwank wiibʼ xkokʼal ut aʼan laj Dan ut laj Neftali. Joʼkan ajwiʼ li xLea kixkʼe li xmoos, xZilpa, re laj Jacob. Li xZilpa kiwank wiibʼ xkokʼal ut aʼanebʼ: laj Gad ut laj Aser. Chirix chik aʼan, li xLea kiwank wiibʼ chik xkokʼal rikʼin laj Jacob ut aʼanebʼ: laj Isacar ut laj Zabulon.

Tojaʼ naq li xRaquel kiwank jun xkʼuulaʼal. Aj Jose kixkʼe choʼq xkʼabʼaʼ. Moqon chik tqatzol chanru kikʼeheʼk xwankil laj Jose. Chi joʼkan kiwank junlaju ralal laj Jacob naq wank chaq saʼ rochoch laj Laban, xyuwaʼ li xRaquel.

Saʼ li Santil Hu wank ajwiʼ xkʼabʼaʼ li xDina. Aʼan jun rehebʼ li xrabʼin laj Jacob.

Saʼ jun kutan laj Jacob kixkanabʼ laj Laban ut kisutqʼiik Canaan. Kixkʼam chirix li xjunkabʼal ut chixjunil li xketomq.

Kachʼin chik ma nekeʼwulak Efrat, xteepal Canaan, naq kiyoʼlaak li jun chik xkʼuulaʼal li xRaquel. Abʼan naq kiyoʼlaak li kʼuulaʼal, li xRaquel kikamk. Joʼkan naq laj Jacob kixkʼe choʼq aj Benjamin xkʼabʼaʼ li ralal.

Us naq tqajultika xkʼabʼaʼebʼ li ralal laj Jacob, xbʼaan naq saʼ xkʼabʼaʼebʼ kichalk li 12 xteepal li tenamit Israel. Lajeebʼ kichalk chirixebʼ li ralal laj Jacob ut wiibʼ chirixebʼ li ralal laj Jose. Toj yoʼyo laj Isaac naq keʼyoʼlaak chixjunilebʼ li ri ut kisahoʼk tana saʼ xchʼool chi rilbʼalebʼ. Abʼan, ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixkʼul xDina, li ri laj Isaac?Génesis 29:32-35; 30:1-26; 35:16-19; 37:35. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

MA NAKAANAW rikʼin anihebʼ wank xDina? Wank rikʼinebʼ li ixqaʼal re Canaan. Ma sa saʼ xchʼool laj Jacob naq xDina nawulak Canaan? Re xnawbʼal aʼin, us naq tqajultika kʼaru kixkʼoxla laj Abrahan ut laj Isaac chirixebʼ laj Canaan. Ma kiraj laj Abrahan naq li ralal tsumlaaq rikʼin junaq ixq aj Canaan? Ma kiraj laj Isaac ut li xRebeca naq laj Jacob tsumlaaq rikʼin junaq ixq aj Canaan? Inkʼaʼ keʼraj. Ma nakaanaw kʼaʼut?

Xbʼaan naq ebʼ laj Canaan nekeʼxloqʼoni li pechʼbʼil yos ut maaʼusebʼ xnaʼlebʼ. Moko us ta naq ebʼ laj Israel teʼsumlaaq rikʼinebʼ ut teʼwanq choʼq ramiiwebʼ. Joʼkan naq chʼolchʼo chiqu naq laj Jacob moko sa ta saʼ xchʼool naq li xrabʼin wank choʼq ramiiwebʼ laj Canaan.

Li xDina kixkʼe ribʼ saʼ chʼaʼajkilal. Ma nakaanaw ani li winq yook chi ilok re xDina? Aʼan laj Siquem. Naq li xDina kiwulak rilbʼal ebʼ li ixqaʼal saʼ li tenamit Canaan, laj Siquem kixchap ut kiyoklaak rikʼin. Moko us ta kixbʼaanu laj Siquem. Xbʼaan naq, jun li winq naru nayokla rikʼin jun li ixq, wi sumsu rikʼin. Naq laj Siquem kixchap li xDina, naabʼal li chʼaʼajkilal kichalk saʼ xbʼeenebʼ.

Naq ebʼ li ras li xDina keʼxnaw aʼin, kʼajoʼ naq keʼchalk xjosqʼil. Maakʼaʼ saʼ xchʼoolebʼ laj Canaan naq kiwulak laj Simeon, laj Levi ut ebʼ li riitzʼin chi xkamsinkil laj Siquem ut chixjunilebʼ li winq. Laj Jacob kichalk xjosqʼil naq kirabʼi li keʼxbʼaanu ebʼ li ralal.

Ma jultik aawe chanru kitikla li chʼaʼajkilal aʼin? Kitikla naq li xDina kiʼok rochbʼeeninkilebʼ li inkʼaʼ nekeʼxpaabʼ li xchaqʼrabʼ li Yos. Joʼkan naq laaʼo inkʼaʼ tqasikʼ wank rikʼinebʼ li inkʼaʼ nekeʼxpaabʼ li Jehobʼa.Génesis 34:1-31. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Kʼaʼut Ra saʼ Xchʼool laj Jose?
data.contenido:
KʼAJOʼ xrahil saʼ xchʼool laj Jose! Ebʼ li ras keʼxkʼayi rikʼinebʼ li winq li yookebʼ chi xik Egipto. Aran keʼxkʼe choʼq moos. Kʼaʼut naq keʼxkʼayi laj Jose? Xbʼaan naq ebʼ li ras keʼxkaqali.

Laj Jacob kʼajoʼ naq kixra laj Jose, joʼkan naq kixkʼe jun xchʼinaʼusil aqʼ. Naq laj Jacob kixbʼaanu aʼin, ebʼ li ralal keʼok xkaqalinkil laj Jose ut xikʼ rilbʼal. Abʼan wank jun chik xyaalal kʼaʼut xikʼ kiʼileʼk laj Jose.

Laj Jose kiwank wiibʼ xmatkʼ. Saʼebʼ li matkʼ aʼin, laj Jose kiril naq ebʼ li ras keʼxwiqʼibʼ ribʼ chiru. Naq laj Jose kixseeraqʼi li xmatkʼ rehebʼ li ras, keʼnumtaak xjosqʼil saʼ xbʼeen.

Saʼ jun kutan ebʼ li ras laj Jose, yookebʼ chaq chi rilbʼal xkarneer li xyuwaʼ. Joʼkan naq laj Jacob kixtaqla laj Jose chi rilbʼalebʼ. Naq ebʼ li ras laj Jose keʼril naq yook chaq chi chalk, keʼok xyeebʼal: ‹Qakamsihaq!› Abʼan laj Ruben kixye: ‹Inkʼaʼ, meebʼaanu aʼan!› Joʼkan naq keʼxchʼik saʼ jun li jul ut keʼok xkʼuubʼankil kʼaru teʼxbʼaanu rikʼin. Chirix chik aʼan, yookebʼ chaq chi chalk jun chʼuut aj Ismael. Tojaʼ naq laj Juda kixye: ‹Qakʼayihaq rikʼinebʼ laj Ismael›. Joʼkan naq keʼxkʼayi laj Jose rikʼin junmay li tumin re plaat. Yiibʼru keʼxbʼaanu re laj Jose!

Abʼan, kʼaru keʼxye chaq re li xyuwaʼ? Keʼxkamsi jun li chibʼaat ut saʼ li xkikʼel keʼxtzʼa naabʼal sut li raqʼ laj Jose. Tojaʼ naq keʼxkʼam re li xyuwaʼ ut keʼxye re: ‹Xqataw aʼin; il mare aʼan li raqʼ laj Jose›.

Laj Jacob saʼ junpaat kixkʼe reetal naq aʼan li raqʼ laj Jose, joʼkan naq kixye: ‹Jun josqʼ aj xul tana kinuqʼuk re li walal!› Aʼin keʼraj li ras laj Jose naq tixkʼoxla li xyuwaʼebʼ. Kʼajoʼ naq kirahoʼk saʼ xchʼool laj Jacob! Naabʼal kutan kixyaabʼa li ralal. Abʼan laj Jose moko kamenaq ta, qilaq kʼaru kixkʼul.Génesis 37:1-35. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

LAJ Jose wank 17 chihabʼ re naq kikʼameʼk Egipto. Saʼ li tenamit aʼin laj Potifar kiloqʼok re laj Jose. Laj Potifar aʼan xmoos laj Faraon, li awabʼej re Egipto.

Laj Jose kikʼanjelak chi kaw saʼ rochoch laj Potifar. Naq kiwinqiloʼk laj Jose, laj Potifar kixkanabʼ saʼ ruqʼ chixjunil li wank saʼ rochoch. Abʼan, kʼaʼut wank saʼ tzʼalam laj Jose? Saʼ xmaak li rixaqil laj Potifar.

Laj Jose chʼinaʼus naʼilok. Joʼkan naq li rixaqil laj Potifar kiraj naq laj Jose tyoklaaq rikʼin. Laj Jose inkʼaʼ kiraj xbʼaan naq naxnaw naq nimla maak xbʼaanunkil aʼin. Joʼkan naq kichalk xjosqʼil li rixaqil laj Potifar. Li ixq kixye re li xbʼeelom: ‹Maaʼus xnaʼlebʼ laj Jose, kiraj inmuxbʼal!› Laj Potifar kixpaabʼ re li rixaqil. Joʼkan naq kichalk xjosqʼil ut kixkʼe saʼ tzʼalam laj Jose.

Laj kʼaakʼalenel tzʼalam kixkʼe reetal naq laj Jose chaabʼil xnaʼlebʼ. Joʼkan naq kixkanabʼ saʼ ruqʼ laj Jose chixjunilebʼ li wankebʼ saʼ tzʼalam. Moqon chik laj Faraon kixkʼe saʼ tzʼalam laj kʼehol ukʼaʼ ut laj yiibʼanel kaxlan wa. Saʼ jun qʼoqyink, ebʼ li wiibʼ chi winq aʼin keʼmatkʼek, abʼan inkʼaʼ keʼxnaw xyaalal ebʼ li xmatkʼ. Naq kisaqewk laj Jose kixye rehebʼ: ‹Seeraqʼimaq we leematkʼ›. Li Yos kitenqʼank re laj Jose chi xnawbʼal xyaalal ebʼ li matkʼ.

Laj Jose kixye re laj kʼehol ukʼaʼ: ‹Saʼ oxibʼ kutan tat-elq saʼ tzʼalam ut tat-oq wiʼ chik chi kʼanjelak chiru laj Faraon›. Kixye ajwiʼ re: ‹Chat-aatinaq chiwix rikʼin laj Faraon re naq tinrisi saʼ tzʼalam›. Re laj yiibʼanel kaxlan wa kixye: ‹Saʼ oxibʼ kutan laj Faraon tatxkamsi›.

Naq kiwulak li oxibʼ kutan keʼxkʼul tzʼaqal joʼ kixye laj Jose. Laj Faraon kixkamsi laj yiibʼanel kaxlan wa. Ut kirisi saʼ tzʼalam laj kʼehol ukʼaʼ ut kiʼok wiʼ chik chi kʼanjelak chiru li awabʼej. Abʼan, laj kʼehol ukʼaʼ kisach saʼ xchʼool aatinak chirix laj Jose rikʼin laj Faraon, joʼkan naq laj Jose toj kikanaak saʼ tzʼalam.Génesis 39:1-23; 40:1-23. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

AK WIIBʼ chihabʼ relik saʼ tzʼalam laj kʼehol ukʼaʼ ut laj Jose toj wank saʼ tzʼalam. Laj kʼehol ukʼaʼ kisach saʼ xchʼool aatinak chirix laj Jose. Laj Faraon wank wiibʼ li xmatkʼ, abʼan inkʼaʼ naxnaw xyaalal. Saʼ li eetalil nakʼutunk naq yook chi matkʼek. Naq kisaqewk laj Faraon kixtaqla xbʼoqbʼalebʼ laj qʼe ut kixye rehebʼ li xmatkʼ. Abʼan inkʼaʼ keʼxtaw xyaalal.

Tojaʼ naq laj kʼehol ukʼaʼ kixye re laj Faraon: ‹Saʼ tzʼalam wank jun li winq naxnaw xyaalal ebʼ li matkʼ›. Joʼkan naq laj Faraon kirisi laj Jose saʼ tzʼalam. Laj Faraon kixseeraqʼi li xmatkʼ re laj Jose: ‹Kiwil wuqubʼ chi wakax chʼinaʼusebʼ ut ninqebʼ xtibʼel. Ut kiwil wuqubʼ chi wakax yiibʼebʼ ru ut bʼaqebʼ xtibʼel. Ut ebʼ li wakax, li bʼaqebʼ xtibʼel, keʼxnuqʼ li wakax li ninqebʼ xtibʼel›.

‹Saʼ xkabʼ ru linmatkʼ, kiwil saʼ jun xtoonal li triiw wank wuqubʼ chiij ru li triiw ut chaqʼalebʼ li ru. Ut kiwil saʼ jun xtoonal li triiw wank wuqubʼ chiij li triiw ut chaqihebʼ li ru. Ebʼ li chaqi triiw keʼok xnuqʼbʼal ebʼ li chaabʼil triiw›. Laj Jose kixye re laj Faraon: ‹Juntaqʼeetebʼ xyaalal laamatkʼ. Li wuqubʼ chi chaabʼil wakax ut li wuqubʼ chi chaabʼil triiw, naraj xyeebʼal wuqubʼ chihabʼ. Li wuqubʼ chi chaqi wakax ut li wuqubʼ chi chaqi triiw, naraj xyeebʼal wuqubʼ chihabʼ chik. Joʼkan naq, chiru wuqubʼ chihabʼ twanq naabʼal li tzakahemq. Ut chiru li wuqubʼ chihabʼ chik tmaakʼaʼoq li tzakahemq›.

Joʼkan naq, laj Jose kixye re laj Faraon: ‹Sikʼ junaq winq wank xnaʼlebʼ, re naq tixchʼutubʼ li tzakahemq chiru li wuqubʼ chihabʼ naq twanq li tzakahemq. Chi joʼkan maaʼani tkamq chiruhebʼ li chihabʼ naq tmaakʼaʼoq li tzakahemq›.

Laj Faraon kiwulak chiru li kixye laj Jose. Joʼkan naq laj Faraon kixxaqabʼ laj Jose re naq aʼan tchʼutubʼanq re li tzakahemq ut tixxok. Laj Faraon kixkʼe xwankil laj Jose saʼ li tenamit Egipto.

Jun chihabʼ rokik li weʼej, naq laj Jose kiril naq yookebʼ chaq chi chalk jun chʼuut chi winq. Ma nakaanaw anihebʼ? Aʼanebʼ li 10 chi ras laj Jose. Laj Jacob kixtaqlahebʼ li ralal saʼ li tenamit Egipto xbʼaan naq saʼ li tenamit Canaan maakʼaʼ chik li tzakahemq. Laj Jose kixnawebʼ ru li ras, abʼan aʼanebʼ inkʼaʼ chik keʼxnaw ru laj Jose. Kʼaʼut naq inkʼaʼ chik keʼxnaw ru? Xbʼaan naq laj Jose moko saaj ta chik ut jalan chik naxtiqibʼ ribʼ.

Laj Jose kijultikoʼk re naq kixmatkʼe naq ebʼ li ras keʼxwiqʼibʼ ribʼ chiru. Ma jultik aawe naq ak xaatzol aʼin? Laj Jose kixkʼe reetal naq wank xyaalal naq li Yos kixkʼam chaq Egipto. Ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixbʼaanu laj Jose rikʼinebʼ li ras? Saʼ li jun chik tzolom tqatzol aʼin.Génesis 41:1-57; 42:1-8; 50:20. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Laj Jose Kixyalebʼ Rix li Ras
data.contenido:
LAJ Jose kiraj xnawbʼal ma ak keʼxjal xnaʼlebʼ li 10 chi ras. Joʼkan naq kixye rehebʼ: ‹Laaʼex aj chʼuuk, xexchalk chi rilbʼal qatenamit›.

Keʼchaqʼok li ras: ‹Inkʼaʼ, moko yaal ta, laaʼo tiik qachʼool. Qiitzʼin qibʼ ut kabʼlajuho naq xoowank chaq. Jun rehebʼ li qiitzʼin maaʼani chik ut li jun chik wank rikʼin li qayuwaʼ›.

Laj Jose kixbʼaanu ribʼ naq inkʼaʼ kixpaabʼ rehebʼ. Joʼkan naq kixkanabʼ laj Simeon saʼ tzʼalam. Kixtaqlahebʼ li bʼeleebʼ saʼ rochoch li xyuwaʼ ut kixye rehebʼ naq teʼxkʼam li tzakahemq. Kixye ajwiʼ rehebʼ: ‹Naq texsutqʼiiq teekʼam chaq we leeriitzʼin, li toj saaj saʼ leeyanq›.

Naq keʼwulak Canaan, keʼxye re li xyuwaʼ li keʼxkʼul chaq. Joʼkan naq laj Jacob kirahoʼk saʼ xchʼool. Chirix chik aʼan laj Jacob kixye: ‹Maaʼani chik laj Jose ut maaʼani wiʼ chik laj Simeon. Moko tinkanabʼ ta naq teʼxkʼam laj Benjamin li xkachʼinal ru li walal›. Abʼan yook chi raqeʼk li tzakahemq joʼkan naq laj Jacob kixkanabʼ naq teʼxkʼam laj Benjamin re naq teʼxkʼam chaq xkomon li tzakahemq.

Naq laj Jose kiril naq yookebʼ chaq chi chalk li ras, kʼajoʼ naq kisahoʼk saʼ xchʼool xbʼaan naq kiril ru laj Benjamin. Abʼan maajun rehebʼ kixnaw naq li winq aʼin, aʼan laj Jose. Ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixbʼaanu laj Jose re xyalbʼalebʼ rix li ras?

Laj Jose kixye rehebʼ li xmoos naq teʼxnujobʼresi chi tzakahemq li xnaʼajebʼ li riiq. Laj Jose kixye ajwiʼ naq teʼxkʼe saʼ li riiq laj Benjamin, jun li sekʼ re plaat. Ak najt chik teʼwulaq li ras, naq laj Jose kixtaqlahebʼ li xmoos chirixebʼ. Naq koxeʼtaweʼk keʼyeheʼk re: ‹Kʼaʼut naq xeerelqʼa chaq li xsekʼ li awabʼej?›

Keʼchaqʼok ut keʼxye: ‹Maaʼani qe kiʼelqʼank re li sekʼ. Wi teetaw li sekʼ saʼ junaq rehebʼ li qiiq, aʼan tkamq›.

Joʼkan naq, ebʼ li moos keʼok xsikʼbʼal li sekʼ saʼebʼ li junjunq chi iiq. Keʼxtaw li sekʼ saʼ li riiq laj Benjamin, joʼ nakaawil saʼ li eetalil. Tojaʼ naq ebʼ li moos keʼxye: ‹Naru texxik, abʼan laj Benjamin txik chiqix›. Ma nakaanaw kʼaru keʼxbʼaanu ebʼ li ras laj Jose?

Chixjunilebʼ keʼsutqʼiik saʼ rochoch laj Jose. Laj Jose kixye rehebʼ: ‹Ayuqex saʼ leerochoch, abʼan laj Benjamin tkanaaq choʼq inmoos›.

Tojaʼ naq kixye laj Juda: ‹Wi tinwulaq saʼ ochoch ut inkʼaʼ tinkʼam li wiitzʼin tkamq linyuwaʼ, xbʼaan naq kʼajoʼ naxra. Bʼaanu usilal, kanaqin choʼq aamoos abʼan kanabʼ chi xik li wiitzʼin›.

Chi joʼkan kixkʼe reetal laj Jose naq ebʼ li ras, keʼxjal xnaʼlebʼ. Anaqwan, qilaq kʼaru kixbʼaanu laj Jose.Génesis 42:9-38; 43:1-34; 44:1-34. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Li Xjunkabʼal laj Jacob Xko Egipto
data.contenido:
LAJ Jose inkʼaʼ chik kixkuy xyaabʼ, joʼkan naq kixye rehebʼ li xmoos: ‹Elenqex chiwu!› Naq laj Jose kikanaak rochbʼeenebʼ li ras kiʼok chi yaabʼak. Kʼajoʼ naq keʼsach xchʼool chi rilbʼal. Inkʼaʼ nekeʼxnaw kʼaru naxkʼul. Tojaʼ naq kixye laj Jose rehebʼ li ras: ‹Laaʼin laj Jose. Ma toj yoʼyo linyuwaʼ?›

Sachsookebʼ xchʼool keʼkanaak ut inkʼaʼ keʼxsume. Kʼajoʼ naq keʼxuwak. Joʼkan naq laj Jose kixye rehebʼ: ‹Bʼaanumaq usilal, jilonqex chaq!› Naq keʼjilok, kixye rehebʼ: ‹Laaʼin laj Jose, leeriitzʼin, li keʼkʼayi rehebʼ laj Egipto›.

Laj Jose kiʼaatinak saʼ tuulanil rikʼinebʼ li ras ut kixye rehebʼ: ‹Moko laaʼex ta wank eere naq xineekʼayi. Li Yos kikʼamok chaq we Egipto, re xkolbʼalebʼ li qas qiitzʼin. Laj Faraon kixkʼe inwankil saʼ li tenamit Egipto. Yemaq chaq re linyuwaʼ re naq tchalq›.

Tojaʼ naq laj Jose kixqʼaluhebʼ ut kixtzʼubʼebʼ ru li ras. Naq laj Faraon kirabʼi naq ebʼ li ras laj Jose keʼwulak Egipto, kixye re laj Jose: ‹Xkʼamaqebʼ li bʼelebʼaal chʼiichʼ re naq teʼxkʼam chaq laayuwaʼ ut chixjunilebʼ laakomon ut chalqebʼ saʼ li tenamit aʼin. Tinkʼe rehebʼ li xchaabʼilal ru li naʼajej li wank Egipto›.

Joʼkan naq kichalk chixjunil li xjunkabʼal laj Jacob saʼ li tenamit Egipto. Saʼ li eetalil nakʼutunk naq laj Jose yook xqʼalunkil li xyuwaʼ. Ebʼ li ralal ut ebʼ li ri laj Jacob 70 chixjunilebʼ naq keʼwulak Egipto. Kohebʼ ajwiʼ li ixaqilbʼej ut naabʼalebʼ li moos. Chixjunilebʼ keʼkanaak Egipto. Keʼkʼabʼaʼiik choʼq ebʼ aj Israel, xbʼaan naq li Yos kixjal xkʼabʼaʼ laj Jacob choʼq aj Israel. Chi joʼkan keʼkanaak choʼq xtenamit li Yos.Génesis 45:1-28; 46:1-27. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

data.titulo: Laj Job Tiik Xchʼool Chiru li Yos
data.contenido:
TOQʼOBʼ ru li winq nujenaq saʼ xox! Aʼan laj Job. Li ixq li wank chiru laj Job aʼan li rixaqil. Li rixaqil laj Job yook xyeebʼal re: ‹Maajewa li Yos ut tatkamq›. Kʼaʼut naq li rixaqil laj Job kixye aʼin? Ut kʼaʼut kichalk li rahilal saʼ xbʼeen laj Job?

Laj Job tiik xchʼool chiru li Jehobʼa. Laj Job kiwank saʼ li tenamit Uz. Li tenamit aʼin, moko najt ta wank chiru Canaan. Li Jehobʼa naxra laj Job. Abʼan, ma nakaanaw ani xikʼ naʼilok re laj Job?

Laj Tza aʼan li musiqʼej li xikʼ naʼilok re li Jehobʼa. Aʼan kixbʼaanu naq laj Adan ut xʼEva teʼxqʼet Raatin li Yos. Laj Tza kixkʼoxla ajwiʼ naq truuq xbʼaanunkil naq chixjunilebʼ teʼxqʼet Raatin li Yos. Abʼan, ma kiru laj Tza xbʼaanunkil aʼin? Inkʼaʼ kiru xbʼaanunkil. Qajultikaq naq keʼwank winq ut ixq tiikebʼ xchʼool chiru li Yos. Ma jultik aawe anihebʼ xkʼabʼaʼ?

Laj Job chik kikanaak naq kikamk laj Jacob ut laj Jose. Laj Job jwal tiik xchʼool chiru li Jehobʼa saʼ chixjunil li Ruuchichʼochʼ. Li Jehobʼa kiraj xkʼutbʼal chiru laj Tza naq moko truuq ta xbʼaanunkil naq chixjunilebʼ yiibʼaqebʼ ru xnaʼlebʼ. Joʼkan naq kixye re laj Tza: ‹Chaawil laj Job. Tiik xchʼool chiwu›.

Laj Tza kixye re li Yos: ‹Laj Job tiik xchʼool chaawu, xbʼaan naq nakaawosobʼtesi. Abʼan wi taamaqʼ chixjunil chiru, tatxmaajewa›.

Joʼkan naq li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Tza: ‹Maqʼ chixjunil chiru ut rahobʼtesi abʼan maakamsi. Ut aran tqil ma tinxmaajewa›. Joʼkan naq laj Tza kixbʼaanu naq teʼrelqʼa li xketomq, ebʼ li xkameey ut teʼkamq ebʼ li xkarneer. Kixbʼaanu naq teʼkamq li 10 chi ralal xkʼajol saʼ jun kaqsut-iqʼ. Chirix chik aʼan kixkʼe li yajel aʼin chirix laj Job. Nim li xrahilal laj Job, joʼkan naq li rixaqil kixye: ‹Maajewa li Yos ut tatkamq›. Abʼan laj Job moko kixbʼaanu ta li kixye li rixaqil. Ut oxibʼebʼ li nekeʼxye naq ramiiw, keʼxye re laj Job naq yook xtojbʼal rix li maaʼusilal li kixbʼaanu chaq. Abʼan laj Job moko kixkanabʼ ta wank saʼ tiikilal chiru li Yos.

Laj Job kixsahobʼresi xchʼool li Jehobʼa. Li Yos kirosobʼtesi laj Job kixkʼirtesi ut kixkʼe 10 chik ralal xkʼajol. Joʼkan ajwiʼ kixkʼe kaʼsut xkʼihal li xketomq, li xkarneer ut li xkameey chiru li kiwank chaq najter. Joʼ li nakaawil saʼ li eetalil.

Wi tiikaq aachʼool chi junelik chiru li Jehobʼa, joʼ kixbʼaanu chaq laj Job. Li Yos tatrosobʼtesi ajwiʼ ut tixkʼe aayuʼam chi junelik naq li Ruuchichʼochʼ twulaq joʼ li naʼajej Eden.Job 1:1-22; 2:1-13; 42:10-17. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

EBʼ LI winq li yookebʼ chi taqlank chi kaw, aʼanebʼ laj Egipto. Jun laj Egipto yook xsakʼbʼal li moos. Li yookebʼ chi kʼanjelak saʼ li tenamit aʼin, aʼanebʼ laj Israel, ralal xkʼajol laj Jacob. Ebʼ laj Israel keʼkanaak choʼq xmoosebʼ laj Egipto. Chanru kikʼulmank aʼin?

Chiru naabʼal chihabʼ li xjunkabʼal laj Jacob sa keʼwank Egipto. Saʼ li tenamit aʼin, laj Faraon kixkʼe xwankil laj Jose. Joʼkan naq laj Jose kiʼilok re li xjunkabʼal laj Jacob. Abʼan laj Jose kikamk. Chirix chik aʼan, kiʼok chi jolomink jun chik laj Faraon ut aʼan moko sa ta kirilebʼ laj Israel.

Laj Faraon aʼin, kixkʼehebʼ laj Israel choʼq xmoos. Ebʼ laj Egipto maaʼusebʼ xnaʼlebʼ. Joʼkan naq kaw keʼtaqlank saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Israel re naq teʼxyiibʼ ebʼ li tenamit choʼq re laj Faraon. Moqon chik, ebʼ laj Israel keʼok chi naabʼaloʼk. Joʼkan naq ebʼ laj Egipto keʼok chi xuwak ut keʼxkʼoxla naq naru teʼnumtaaq ebʼ laj Israel saʼ xbʼeenebʼ. Ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixbʼaanu laj Faraon? Kixye rehebʼ laj xokol kʼuulaʼal: ‹Teekamsi li kokʼ chʼinaʼal li yooqebʼ chi yoʼlaak›. Abʼan ebʼ li ixq aʼin chaabʼilebʼ xnaʼlebʼ ut inkʼaʼ keʼxkamsi li kokʼ chʼinaʼal.

Joʼkan naq laj Faraon kixkʼe jun li chaqʼrabʼ saʼ li tenamit: ‹Teekamsi chixjunilebʼ li kokʼ chʼinaʼal ebʼ aj Israel. Abʼan meekamsi li kokʼ ixqaʼal›. Yiibʼru xnaʼlebʼ laj Faraon, peʼyaal? Qilaq chanru kikoleʼk jun li chʼinaʼal.Éxodo 1:6-22. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

ANI li kʼuulaʼal yook chi yaabʼak? Aʼan laj Moises. Ma nakaanaw ani li ixqaʼal li wank chiru laj Moises? Aʼan xrabʼin laj Faraon.

Naq kiyoʼlaak laj Moises kimuqeʼk xbʼaan li xnaʼ re naq inkʼaʼ tkamsiiq. Li xnaʼ laj Moises naxnaw naq ebʼ laj Egipto teʼxtaw li xkʼuulaʼal. Joʼkan naq, ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixkʼul laj Moises naq wank oxibʼ po re?

Li xnaʼ laj Moises kixyiibʼ chiʼus jun li chakach re naq inkʼaʼ t-oq haʼ chisaʼ. Kixkʼe laj Moises saʼ li chakach ut kixkanabʼ chaq saʼ xbʼeen li pim, chire li nimaʼ Nilo. Li xMiriam, ranabʼ laj Moises, kikanaak saʼ pim re rilbʼal kʼaru tixkʼul li riitzʼin. Chirix chik aʼan, li xrabʼin laj Faraon kiwulak chi atink saʼ li nimaʼ ut kiril li chakach. Tojaʼ naq kixye re jun rehebʼ li xmoos: ‹Kʼam chaq we li chakach aʼan›. Naq li xrabʼin laj Faraon kixte re li chakach, kiril jun li kʼuulaʼal kʼajoʼ xchʼinaʼusal! Laj Moises yook chi yaabʼak. Joʼkan naq li xrabʼin laj Faraon kiyotʼeʼk xchʼool chi rilbʼal ut inkʼaʼ kiraj naq tkamsiiq.

Li xMiriam xko chixkʼatq li xrabʼin laj Faraon ut kixye re: ‹Ma taawaj naq tinbʼoq chaq junaq ixq aj Israel re naq tixkʼirisi li kʼuulaʼal?›

Li xrabʼin laj Faraon kixye re xMiriam: ‹Ayu, bʼaanu usilal!›

Li xMiriam kixye chaq re li xnaʼ. Naq li xnaʼ kiwulak rikʼin xrabʼin laj Faraon, kiyeheʼk re: ‹Kʼam li kʼuulaʼal aʼin ut tatintoj chi rilbʼal›.

Chi joʼkan laj Moises kikʼirisiik xbʼaan li xnaʼ. Naq kinimank laj Moises, kikʼameʼk xbʼaan li xnaʼ saʼ rochoch laj Faraon. Chirix chik aʼan, li xrabʼin laj Faraon kikanaak choʼq xnaʼ laj Moises. Joʼkan naq laj Moises kikʼiik saʼ rochoch laj Faraon.Éxodo 2:1-10. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

LAJ Moises yook chi elelik. Ma nakaanaw kʼaʼut keʼraj xkamsinkil laj Moises? Qilaq kʼaʼut yookebʼ xtaqenkil.

Laj Moises kikʼiik saʼ rochoch laj Faraon, joʼkan naq wank xwankil ut wank xnawom. Abʼan naxnaw naq aʼan aj Israel ut moko xkomonebʼ ta laj Egipto.

Laj Moises wank 40 chihabʼ re naq xko rilbʼal chanru wankebʼ li xkomon. Laj Moises kiril naq ra wankebʼ laj Israel. Jun laj Egipto yook xsakʼbʼal jun rehebʼ laj Israel. Naq laj Moises kiril naq maaʼani yook chi ilok re, kixkamsi laj Egipto. Tojaʼ naq kixmuq rubʼel li samahibʼ.

Naq kisaqewk, laj Moises xko wiʼ chik chi rilbʼalebʼ laj Israel. Kixkʼoxla naq truuq xtenqʼankilebʼ re naq teʼxkanabʼ wank choʼq xmoosebʼ laj Egipto. Naq kiril wiibʼ laj Israel yookebʼ xsakʼbʼal ribʼebʼ kixye: ‹Kʼaʼut nakaasakʼ laakomon?›

Kichaqʼok li winq li yook chi sakʼok: ‹Ani xyehok aawe naq tatraqoq aatin saʼ qabʼeen? Ma tinaakamsi joʼ xaakamsi laj Egipto?›

Kʼajoʼ naq kixuwak laj Moises xbʼaan naq kixkʼe reetal naq ak nekeʼxnaw chik li kixbʼaanu re laj Egipto. Ut naq laj Faraon kirabʼi naq laj Moises kixkamsi laj Egipto, kixtaqla xkamsinkil. Joʼkan naq kiʼelelik laj Moises.

Naq laj Moises kiʼelk Egipto, kiwulak saʼ jun najtil tenamit, Madian xkʼabʼaʼ. Saʼ li tenamit aʼin kixnaw ru laj Jetro ut li xjunkabʼal. Chirix chik aʼan kisumlaak rikʼin xZipora, jun rehebʼ li xrabʼin laj Jetro. Laj Moises kiʼok rilbʼalebʼ li xkarneer laj Jetro. Kaʼkʼaal chihabʼ kiwank laj Moises saʼ li tenamit Madian. Saʼ li jun chik tzolom tqanaw kʼaru kixkʼul laj Moises naq wank 80 chihabʼ re.Éxodo 2:11-25; Hechos 7:22-29. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

LAJ Moises kiwulak saʼ li tzuul Horeb, xbʼaan naq yook xsikʼbʼal richajebʼ li xkarneer. Aran kiril jun li cheʼ yook xxamlel ut inkʼaʼ nakʼatk!

Laj Moises kixye: ‹Xik we chi rilbʼal kʼaru aʼan›. Naq kijilok, kiyeheʼk re: ‹Matjilok chaq, isi laaxaabʼ, xbʼaan naq sant li naʼaj li xaqxookat wiʼ›. Li Yos kiʼaatinank re laj Moises, abʼan kiroksi jun li anjel re xbʼaanunkil aʼin. Naq laj Moises kirabʼi xyaabʼ xkux li Jehobʼa kixtzʼap xnaqʼ ru.

Tojaʼ naq li Yos kixye re laj Moises: ‹Yookin chi rilbʼal naq ra wank lintenamit. Joʼkan naq nawaj xkolbʼalebʼ ut tattintaqla Egipto chi risinkilebʼ›. Li Jehobʼa naraj naq ebʼ laj Israel teʼxik saʼ li chʼinaʼusil naʼajej Canaan.

Laj Moises kixye re li Yos: ‹Anihin laaʼin? Chanru twisihebʼ chaq laatenamit? Wi teʼxpatzʼ we: Ani kitaqlank chaq aawe? Kʼaru tinye rehebʼ?›

Li Yos kixye re laj Moises: ‹Aʼin taaye: Li JEHOBʼA li xYos laj Abrahan, li xYos laj Isaac ut li xYos laj Jacob kitaqlank chaq we eerikʼin›. Li Jehobʼa kixye ajwiʼ re laj Moises: ‹Aʼinaq linkʼabʼaʼ chi junelik!›

Kichaqʼok laj Moises: ‹Ut wi inkʼaʼ teʼxpaabʼ we naq tinye rehebʼ naq laaʼat xattaqlank chaq we?›

Joʼkan naq li Yos kixye re: ‹Kʼaru wank saʼ laawuqʼ?›

Laj Moises kixye: ‹Jun li cheʼ›.

Li Yos kixye re laj Moises: ‹Kut li cheʼ saʼ chʼochʼ›. Naq kixkut saʼ chʼochʼ, li cheʼ kisutqʼiik choʼq kʼantiʼ. Li Jehobʼa kixkʼut jun chik li eetalil chiru laj Moises. Ut kixye re: ‹Chʼik laawuqʼ saʼ laawaqʼ›. Naq laj Moises kirisi li ruqʼ, kiril naq wank saqlep chiru li ruqʼ! Li Jehobʼa toj kixkʼut chiru laj Moises jun chik li eetalil. Chirix chik aʼan li Yos kixye: ‹Rikʼin ebʼ li eetalil aʼin, ebʼ laj Israel teʼxpaabʼ naq laaʼin xintaqlank aawe rikʼinebʼ›.

Naq laj Moises kiwulak saʼ rochoch kixye re laj Jetro: ‹Bʼaanu usilal, kanabʼin chi xik Egipto, re naq tinnaw chanru wankebʼ linkomon›. Joʼkan naq laj Moises kisutqʼiik Egipto.Éxodo 3:1-22; 4:1-20. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

NAQ laj Moises kiwulak Egipto, kiʼaatinak rikʼin laj Aaron, li ras, chirixebʼ li eetalil. Ut naq laj Moises ut laj Aaron keʼxkʼut ebʼ li eetalil aʼin chiruhebʼ laj Israel, chixjunilebʼ keʼxpaabʼ naq li Jehobʼa kitaqlank chaq rehebʼ.

Chirix chik aʼan, laj Moises ut laj Aaron keʼwulak rikʼin laj Faraon ut keʼxye re: ‹Li Jehobʼa, li xYos laj Israel kixye: Kanabʼebʼ chi xik lintenamit saʼ li chaqichʼochʼ chiru oxibʼ kutan, re naq teʼxloqʼoni wu›. Laj Faraon kichaqʼok: ‹Inkʼaʼ ninpaabʼ li Jehobʼa ut inkʼaʼ tinkanabʼebʼ chi xik laj Israel!›

Laj Faraon yook xjosqʼil xbʼaan naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼraj oxibʼ kutan re xloqʼoninkil li Jehobʼa. Joʼkan naq, kixmimebʼ ru chi kʼanjelak. Ebʼ laj Israel keʼxye naq laj Moises wank re, naq laj Faraon kiʼok xrahobʼtesinkilebʼ. Joʼkan naq laj Moises kirahoʼk saʼ xchʼool. Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Moises: ‹Tinbʼaanu naq laj Faraon tixkanabʼ chi xik lintenamit›. Naq laj Moises ut laj Aaron, kohebʼ wiʼ chik rikʼin laj Faraon keʼxbʼaanu jun li eetalil. Laj Aaron kixkut li xcheʼ chiru laj Faraon ut li cheʼ kisutqʼiik choʼq kʼantiʼ. Chirix chik aʼan ebʼ laj qʼe li nekeʼkʼanjelak chiru laj Faraon, keʼxkut ajwiʼ ebʼ li xcheʼ ut keʼsutqʼiik ajwiʼ choʼq kʼantiʼ. Abʼan, li xkʼantiʼ laj Aaron kiʼok xnuqʼbʼalebʼ li xkʼantiʼ ebʼ laj qʼe. Usta laj Faraon kiril li eetalil aʼin inkʼaʼ kixkanabʼebʼ chi xik laj Israel.

Joʼkan naq kiwulak xkutankil naq li Jehobʼa kixkʼut xjosqʼil chiru laj Faraon. Ma nakaanaw kʼaru kixbʼaanu? Kixkʼam chaq 10 li rahilal saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Egipto.

Naq yookebʼ xkʼulbʼal ebʼ li rahilal, laj Faraon kixbʼoq laj Moises ut kixye re: ‹Xaaqabʼ li rahilal ut tinkanabʼebʼ chi xik laj Israel›. Naq kixaqli li rahilal, inkʼaʼ kixkanabʼebʼ chi xik. Toj saʼ xlaje li rahilal, laj Faraon kixkanabʼ chi xik li xtenamit li Jehobʼa.

Qilaq saʼ li jun chik tzolom li 10 chi rahilal li kixtaqla li Yos saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Egipto.Éxodo 4:27-31; 5:1-23; 6:1-13, 26-30; 7:1-13. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

SAʼ LI junjunq chi eetalil nakʼutunk li lajeebʼ chi rahilal kixtaqla li Jehobʼa saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Egipto. Saʼ li xbʼeen rahilal, laj Aaron kixchʼeʼ li nimaʼ Nilo rikʼin li xcheʼ ut li haʼ kisutqʼiik choʼq kikʼ. Ebʼ li kar keʼkamk chisaʼ li nimaʼ ut kiʼok chi chuhoʼk. Saʼ li xkabʼ rahilal, li Jehobʼa kixbʼaanu naq teʼelq chaq li amoch saʼ li nimaʼ Nilo. Ebʼ li amoch keʼxchʼik ribʼ saʼeb li sekʼ, saʼeb li chʼaat ut yalaq bʼar keʼxkʼe ribʼ. Naq keʼkamk ebʼ li amoch, kichuhoʼk chixjunil li tenamit Egipto.

Saʼ li rox rahilal, laj Aaron kixtochʼ li chʼochʼ rikʼin li xcheʼ ut li poqs kisutqʼiik choʼq suq. Ebʼ li kokʼ suq aʼin ra nekeʼxtiw. Chirix chik aʼin, kaʼaj chik ebʼ laj Egipto keʼxkʼul li rahilal. Saʼ li xka rahilal keʼwakliik chaq ebʼ li nimla raxyaat ut keʼok saʼebʼ li rochoch laj Egipto. Saʼ li roʼ rahilal, keʼkamk xketomq ebʼ laj Egipto. Keʼkamk naabʼal li wakax, ebʼ li karneer ut ebʼ li chibʼaat.

Saʼ xwaq li rahilal, laj Moises ut laj Aaron keʼxchap li cha ut keʼxkut chiru iqʼ. Tojaʼ naq, keʼnujak saʼ xox ebʼ laj Egipto ut ebʼ li xul.

Saʼ xwuq li rahilal, naq laj Moises kixtaqsi li ruqʼ saʼ choxa, li Jehobʼa kixtaqla chaq saʼ xbʼeenebʼ laj Egipto li kaaq ut li saqbʼach. Aʼin xnimal ru li saqbʼach keʼril ebʼ laj Egipto. Saʼ xwaqxaq li rahilal, keʼelk chaq li saakʼ malaj ebʼ li chiliʼ. Maajunwa rilomebʼ aʼin ebʼ laj Egipto, chi moko kiʼilmank ta chik. Ebʼ li saakʼ keʼxwaʼ chixjunil li awimq li kixkanabʼ li saqbʼach.

Saʼ xbʼele li rahilal, kiqʼoqyinoʼk li tenamit Egipto chiru oxibʼ kutan. Abʼan li xnaʼajebʼ laj Israel moko kiqʼoqyinoʼk ta.

Saʼ xlaje li rahilal, li Yos kixye rehebʼ laj Israel naq teʼxkʼe xkikʼel chibʼaat malaj karneer chiru roqechal li rokebʼaal li rochochebʼ. Tojaʼ naq li xʼanjel li Yos, kixsuti li tenamit Egipto ut bʼar kiril naq wank kikʼ maaʼani kixchʼeʼ saʼ li ochoch aʼan. Abʼan bʼarwiʼ maakʼaʼ kikʼ, keʼkamk chixjunilebʼ li xbʼeen alalbʼej. Ut keʼkamk ajwiʼ ebʼ li xbʼeen ral li xul.

Toj saʼ li rahilal aʼin laj Faraon kixkanabʼebʼ chi xik laj Israel. Abʼan li xtenamit li Yos yal oybʼeenink aj chik yookebʼ. Saʼ li qʼoqyink ajwiʼ aʼan keʼelk chaq Egipto.Éxodo 7–12. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru

KʼARU yook chi kʼulmank saʼ li eetalil? Laj Moises yook xtiikankil li palaw rikʼin li xcheʼ. Ebʼ laj Israel keʼkoleʼk rikʼin laj Moises. Abʼan, laj Faraon ut ebʼ laj puubʼ yookebʼ chi kamk saʼ haʼ. Qilaq chanru keʼxkʼul aʼin.

Joʼ ak xqatzol, laj Faraon kixkanabʼebʼ chi xik ebʼ laj Israel toj saʼ xlaje li rahilal. Keʼelk chaq Egipto 600.000 tana chi winq ut naabʼal chi ixq ut kokʼal. Joʼkan ajwiʼ naabʼalebʼ laj Egipto keʼelk chaq xbʼaan naq keʼxpaabʼ li Jehobʼa. Keʼrisi chaq ebʼ li xketomq, ebʼ li xkarneer ut ebʼ li xchibʼaat.

Naq ak elkebʼ chaq re laj Israel, keʼxpatzʼ rehebʼ laj Egipto raqʼebʼ, oor ut plaat. Ebʼ laj Egipto keʼxkʼe chixjunil li keʼxpatzʼ ebʼ laj Israel. Xbʼaan naq toj yookebʼ xxiw xbʼaan li xlaje rahilal li keʼxkʼul chaq.

Naq ebʼ laj Israel keʼwulak saʼ li kaqi palaw, keʼok chi hilank. Laj Faraon ut ebʼ laj Egipto yookebʼ xyeebʼal: ‹Kʼaʼut naq xqakanabʼebʼ chi xik ebʼ li qamoos?›

Joʼkan naq laj Faraon ut ebʼ laj puubʼ kohebʼ chirixebʼ laj Israel. Keʼxkʼam 600 li bʼelebʼaal chʼiichʼ li sikʼbʼilebʼ ru, joʼ ajwiʼ chixjunilebʼ li xbʼelebʼaal chʼiichʼ ebʼ laj Egipto.

Kʼajoʼ naq keʼxuwak ebʼ laj Israel naq keʼril ru laj Faraon ut ebʼ laj puubʼ! Keʼxkʼoxla naq maabʼar chik teʼxkol ribʼ, xbʼaan naq chiruhebʼ wank li kaqi palaw ut yookebʼ chaq chi chalk ebʼ laj Egipto. Abʼan li Jehobʼa kixkʼe li choql saʼ xyihebʼ laj Israel ut ebʼ laj Egipto. Joʼkan naq, ebʼ laj Egipto inkʼaʼ chik keʼru chi wulak bʼarwiʼ wankebʼ laj Israel.

Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Moises: ‹Yeʼ laawuqʼ saʼ xbʼeen li palaw›. Naq laj Moises kixbʼaanu, li Jehobʼa kixtaqla chaq jun li kawil iqʼ ut kixjach ribʼ li palaw.

Chaqi li bʼe naq keʼok chi numeʼk ebʼ laj Israel saʼ xyi li palaw. Abʼan keʼbʼayk chi numeʼk, xbʼaan naq naabʼalebʼ ut naabʼalebʼ ajwiʼ ebʼ li xketomq. Naq ebʼ laj Egipto keʼril wiʼ chik ruhebʼ laj Israel kohebʼ chirixebʼ ut keʼok saʼ li palaw.

Naq ebʼ laj Egipto wankebʼ saʼ li palaw, li Yos kiʼok xjukʼbʼal ebʼ li xbʼelebʼaal chʼiichʼ. Joʼkan naq keʼxuwak ut keʼok xyeebʼal: ‹Li Jehobʼa yook chi yalok qikʼin, saʼ xkʼabʼaʼ li xtenamit. Elenqo saʼ li palaw!› Abʼan inkʼaʼ chik keʼru chi elelik.

Li Jehobʼa kixye re laj Moises naq tixyeʼ li ruqʼ saʼ xbʼeen li palaw, joʼ nakʼutunk saʼ li eetalil. Tojaʼ naq li palaw kisutqʼiik saʼ xnaʼaj ut ebʼ laj Egipto ut ebʼ li xbʼelebʼaal chʼiichʼ keʼmuqunk rubʼel haʼ. Chixjunilebʼ laj puubʼ wankebʼ saʼ li palaw. Maajun rehebʼ kikoleʼk! Kʼajoʼ naq keʼsahoʼk saʼ xchʼool ebʼ laj Israel! Joʼkan naq ebʼ li winq keʼok chi bʼichank re xbʼanyoxinkil re li Jehobʼa naq keʼkoleʼk: ‹Li Jehobʼa naxnaw yalok. Kixkutebʼ saʼ palaw ebʼ li kawaay ut ebʼ laj puubʼ›. Li xMiriam, ranabʼ laj Moises, kirisi chaq jun li tzojtzoj tun ut ebʼ li rech-ixqilal kohebʼ chirix. Yookebʼ chi xajok ut yookebʼ chi bʼichank ut keʼxye ajwiʼ: ‹Li Jehobʼa naxnaw yalok. Kixkutebʼ saʼ palaw ebʼ li kawaay ut ebʼ laj puubʼ›.Éxodo 12–15. Patzʼom re xtawbʼal ru
